nodes.name: PM Requirements Input
nodes.notes:
🎯 PRODUCT MANAGER INPUT

Receives new design requirements from PM.

POST /webhook/pm-to-ux
Body: {
  "story_id": "STORY-123",
  "requirements": "Create login form...",
  "acceptance_criteria": ["Email validation", ...]
}

nodes.name: Merge Inputs
nodes.notes:
🔀 INPUT COMBINER

Merges both webhook inputs into single flow.

nodes.name: Build Context
nodes.notes:
🏗️ CONTEXT BUILDER

Normalizes input into consistent structure.

Extracts:
- Session ID for tracking
- Input type (chat vs PM)
- User message or requirements
- Current HTML if iterating
- Story metadata

nodes.name: AI UX Designer
nodes.notes:
🤖 AI UX ENGINEER

Generates or updates HTML/CSS designs.

Capabilities:
- Creates designs from requirements
- Iterates based on feedback
- Uses Tailwind CSS
- Responsive & accessible
- Modern best practices

nodes.notes:

Model: GPT-4 Turbo

nodes.name: Design Prompt
nodes.notes:
📝 DYNAMIC PROMPT

Generates appropriate prompt based on:
- New design (PM requirements)
- Iteration (user feedback + current HTML)

nodes.name: Extract & Format HTML
nodes.notes:
🔍 HTML EXTRACTOR

Process:
1. Extract HTML from AI markdown
2. Add Tailwind CDN
3. Add version watermark
4. Create complete preview-ready HTML
